items: Present: **в** is added before the endings: жить — **живу, живёшь, живёт, живём, живёте, живут**; плыть — **плыву, плывёшь**.
Past: regular, with the stress moving: жил, жила, жило, жили.
Only жить, плыть and слыть are of this type, and the verbs made from them with prefixes.

blocks.text: In the DLI Grammar Reference Book
The letter **в** is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb **жить**.
Pattern of the type: Wiktionary, Appendix:Russian verbs, type 16 (CC BY-SA 4.0). Forms and stress marks: OpenRussian (CC BY-SA 4.0).
